Amy Hepworth-Bell is Head of HR & Business Support and is also Evenlode's Company Secretary.

Amy Hepworth-Bell Head of HR & Business Support Amy Hepworth-Bell is Head of HR & Business Support and is also Evenlode's Company Secretary. She is responsible for all HR, facilities and Company Secretary responsibilities and joined Evenlode in 2016. Previously she worked in the Houses of Parliament as a Senior Parliamentary Assistant. Amy graduated from Leicester University with a BA in Politics and from Manchester University with an MA in Politics. She has completed the IMC, holds an Associate Diploma in People Management and is an associate member of the CIPD.
